# Reference Stock gear ratios by model year/trim

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Locate the door frame sticker to find the HG[num] code that identifies your gear ratio. [t2183]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Locate the door frame sticker on the driver's side.
2. Find the HG[num] code at the bottom left corner to identify your ratio.

_Procedure reported by [t2183]._

## Specifications

- **Sticker code for 4.63 gears**: HG46 [t2183] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Sticker code for 4.90 gears**: HG49 [t2183] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Stock gear options for first-gen Xterra**: 4.30, 4.60, or 4.90 [t2183] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Do not rely solely on the trim level name to determine gear ratio. [t2183]
